picks.headline: Meta's Ray-Ban Display glasses get a smarter on-board AI with the new Muse Spark model
picks.excerpt: Meta has begun rolling out an improved Muse Spark AI model to its Ray-Ban Display smart glasses, its only screen-equipped pair. The upgraded on-glasses assistant is described as snappier, more natural, and far better at following what the wearer is doing.
picks.rationale: A real on-device assistant upgrade shipping to screen glasses changes what designers can prototype for glanceable, context-aware AR AI today; distinct event from the earlier Meta glasses review card.

picks.headline: Oura Ring 5 review: a smaller smart ring with on-body Oura Advisor AI coaching
picks.excerpt: A review of the fifth-gen Oura smart ring, 40% smaller than before, with the built-in Oura Advisor AI delivering personalized health guidance from the wearer's biometric data. It makes the case for on-body AI wellness coaching over always-on companion gadgets.
picks.rationale: New hardware plus embedded Oura Advisor AI reframes wearable UX from passive tracking to proactive coaching; a distinct product from the already-published Ultrahuman ring.

picks.headline: iOS 27's new Siri delivers on Apple Intelligence in every way I'd hoped
picks.excerpt: A hands-on with iOS 27's rebuilt Apple Intelligence Siri praises its expanded on-device knowledge, conversational interface, personal-context awareness, and unified in-app actions across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It reads as the first Siri that finally delivers on Apple's AI promises.
picks.rationale: First credible hands-on of the overhauled Siri and its cross-app actions, a system-level AI surface designers must account for; distinct from the niche macOS voice-pad already covered.

picks.headline: Amazon turns Alexa+ into a full-blown app store for smart-home makers
picks.excerpt: Amazon's new Alexa+ developer toolkit lets smart-home device makers plug their full feature sets directly into the AI assistant instead of burying them in separate apps. Bosch, Whirlpool, iRobot, Govee, Yale Home, and Eufy are the first partners onboard.
picks.rationale: An agent-first platform shift, exposing device features to the assistant rather than a companion app, that directly reshapes how designers plan smart-home product experiences.
